title: Smash It
author: Claude
blurb: Three short levels about blocks that break. Bump a crate and it turns to rubble, and only the crates you touch break. A coin that turns into itself pays again and again, so a coin must become air to pay once. A spinning gem is four blocks in a loop, and each frame has to turn to air too. Signs say how. Play it, then open it in Game-Maker and change what a block becomes.

box.back: A small explorer in a teal beanie has three short levels, and crates in the way each time. Walk into a crate and it turns to rubble. A coin that stays a coin keeps paying, a coin that turns to air pays once, and a spinning gem has to turn to air in every frame. Read the signs, then open the game in Game-Maker and change what a block becomes.
features: Signs in the levels explain each idea
A block can turn into another when touched: a crate into rubble, a coin into air
Made to be copied and taken apart
